verdict.rationale: The Washington Department of Revenue runs digital services, including MyDOR online filing and express file, so an official command-line tool is a fair question even if unusual for a tax agency. The evidence only shows web-portal workflows, mail, phone and webinars, and the probes found no OpenAPI, llms.txt or markdown docs. Nothing shows an official CLI exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
